capabilities: assign an accent color to Reading view
assign an accent color to Live Preview
assign an accent color to Source mode
extras: The README recommends pairing it with a theme that highlights the accent color, such as Minimal.
intentEvidence: Set a different accent color for Reading view, Live Preview and Source view.
motivation: The README says it helps users gauge the current view so they don't attempt to edit in Reading view or wonder why footnotes don't work in Live Preview.
problem: Obsidian's accent color is the same in every view mode, so it can be hard to tell at a glance whether you are in Reading view, Live Preview or Source mode.

relations.evidence: works (and looks!) best with an Obsidian theme that highlights the accent color, such as Minimal

summary: Appearance plugin that sets a different accent color for Reading view, Live Preview and Source mode.
